note: The local Google rules library (RAGFlow in Docker Desktop's WSL VM, about 9 GB) runs only while a claude-seo audit needs it, then stops and gives the memory back to Windows (owner 2026-11-17: 就是内存得释放). scripts/lib/rules-library.mjs reads this file; {LOCALAPPDATA} and {HOME} are the user's folders. lockDir is shared by every site's pipeline on this machine. timeouts are milliseconds.

compose.profilesNote: every profile the library runs: its .env COMPOSE_PROFILES (elasticsearch, cpu, metadata-mysql, tei-cpu) and mcp; a --profile on the command line replaces COMPOSE_PROFILES, so with mcp alone compose up never started elasticsearch, mysql, ragflow or tei (2026-11-18: stopped by hand, they stayed down and an audit waited about 20 minutes)

staleSocketPattern: stale|[.]sock.*(exist|in use|denied|refused|failed|remove|cannot be accessed)|only one usage of each socket address
wslNoneRunningPattern: no running distributions|没有正在运行的分发
